title: Metal - Sound Gems [Hypixel Skyblock]
description: A resource pack for Hypixel SkyBlock that adds a Metal clinging sound whenever you break gemstones.
body:
Some of the sound files currently have issues, which may cause the audio to feel a bit off. A fix is on the way that will significantly improve the sound quality, making it much cleaner and more satisfying overall.

Designed for Hypixel SkyBlock, this resource pack enhances audio feedback to make gameplay feel more responsive and enjoyable. Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.1.
